notes.trinkets: As Marksmanship, we want a powerful on-use Trinket to pair with our Trueshot , which is Voracious Heart of Ula'tek . In addition, we pick Font of Venomous Rage . Despite Font technically being an on-use, it does not especially benefit from being cast with Trueshot as it does damage on its own, which allows it to pair up with Heart. Font, properly used on specific fights, can far outperform its sim, especially with damage amps. Until you have Font on 344 iLvl, use Twisted Horror's Tendril .
